function.name: getAsset
function.description: Read one media asset by numeric id.

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of record keys to return; allowed keys: assetId, kind, title, publishedOn; omit for full records

function.name: listAssets
function.description: List assets of one kind, optionally published on/after a date.

kind.description: Asset kind; one of: photo, clip, audio, graphic

publishedAfter.description: Only assets published on/after this date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

function.name: getArticle
function.description: Read one article by its slug identifier.

articleId.description: Article slug; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. ART-city-bees

function.name: listRevisions
function.description: List revisions with one editorial decision, optionally one article and/or review instant.

decision.description: Editorial decision; one of: approved, changes_requested, rejected

articleId.description: Article slug filter; omit for all; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. ART-city-bees

reviewedAfter.description: Only revisions reviewed at/after this instant; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows
